title: Modbus TCP server address wrong
summary: The PLC sends its requests to an address where no device answers.

sections.heading: Recognize it
sections.body: Requests time out and the address is not resolved on the segment; ping to the documented address answers, the configured one does not.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Compare the configured server address with the device documentation and the device's own display or web page.

modeled: Deterministic Modbus TCP client and servers: IPv4 subnet rules, address resolution, unit ID handling of gateways, function 03/04 reads, exceptions 01/02/0B, processing time against the configured timeout, INT and REAL values with word order
approximated: One request at a time per connection
omitted: Writes, other function codes and serial bus timing behind gateways
Byte order inside a register (words are big-endian as the protocol defines)

evidence: Configured address differs from the documentation
troubleshooting.explanation: A connection can only work if it addresses the right device.
